blocks.text: SaaS aisi software applications tak rasai deta hai jo service provider host karta (apne servers par rakhta) aur sambhalta hai. Users bas service ko subscribe karte aur internet par istemal karte hain. Yeh model aakhri user (end-user) ke liye aasan hai kyunke na hardware sambhalna parta hai na software update karna. Misal (Example): Google Workspace (pehle G Suite) mein Gmail, Google Docs aur Google Drive jaisi applications hain. Doosri misalein Microsoft Office 365 aur Salesforce hain.

blocks.alt: Google Cloud Platform Services likhe badal ke gird aath gol nishanon ka pahiya: Compute Services, Management Tools, Cloud AI, IoT (Internet of Things), Security and Identity Management, Big Data, Storage Services aur Networking.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.1: Cloud services ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 6.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh figure ek cloud company (Google Cloud Platform) ki services ke shobe (categories) dikhata hai, jaise compute, storage, networking, big data aur Cloud AI. Yeh IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS ki teen qismein nahi hain jo upar parhi hain; balke ek hi provider in shobon mein IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS teeno tarah ki services deta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Salesforce sab se aage wale SaaS providers mein se hai, jo apne customer relationship management (CRM, yani gahakon ke saath taluqat ka intezam) platform ki wajah se mashhoor hai. Yeh karobaron ko customer data sambhalne, sales ka hisaab rakhne aur marketing ke kaam khud kaar (automate) karne mein madad deta hai. 150,000 se zyada companies apne kaam asaan banane aur gahakon ko zyada mutmain karne ke liye Salesforce istemal karti hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Cloud computing services ki qeemat istemal ke hisaab se hoti hai. Is pay-as-you-go model mein karobar apni zaroorat ke mutabiq resources barha ya ghata sakte hain, jis se yeh sasta aur lachakdar (flexible) ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Kisi cloud service provider (maslan AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) par tehqeeq karein aur bataiye ke asal zindagi ki kisi soorat-e-haal mein us ki services kaise istemal hoti hain. Apni maloomat class ke saamne pesh karein.

blocks.prompt: Inmein se kaunsi cloud service ki qism NAHI hai: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS ya Blockchain as a Service (BaaS) (exercise MCQ 5)?
blocks.explanation: (d) Blockchain as a Service (BaaS). Chapter ki teen bari qismein IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS hain. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (b) deti hai, jo ghalat hai; PaaS to cloud service ki qism hai.)

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: kisi cloud provider ka asal zindagi ka istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan ek company apni website AWS ke virtual servers (IaaS) par chala sakti hai, apne backups cloud storage mein rakh sakti hai, aur staff ko email aur documents ke liye Gmail aur Google Docs (SaaS) de sakti hai. Pesh karte waqt provider ka naam, service ki qism, aur is se kya faida (waqt ya paisa bachna) hua, bataiye.

items: SaaS: provider ki host ki hui tayyar software, internet par subscribe kar ke istemal (Gmail, Office 365, Salesforce).
Na hardware na updates ki fikr; qeemat istemal ke hisaab se (pay-as-you-go).
